useCases.title: Keep the OpenAI SDK, change two fields
useCases.summary: Override baseURL and apiKey, keep the SDK
useCases.problem: The official openai package looks vendor-locked. It is not — it only needs a compatible base URL.

snippets.title: OpenAI SDK

steps: Set baseURL to https://anyrouter.dev/api/v1 and apiKey to your sk-ar key.
Use model "anyrouter/free" or "anyrouter/auto" for the first call.
